env.occupancy.note:
ValueError: min_speed=4.0 was given without speed.
Why: the speed gate compares each interval's start-sample speed with min_speed.
Fix: pass speed= (one value per sample, for example compute_speed(times, positions)), or min_speed=None.

behavior.laps.note:
ValueError: detect_laps(method='auto') counts laps around a loop, but this environment has no loop: its bins connect without a cycle.
Why: on a track the animal runs back and forth, every trip out comes back the way it went, so no lap goes round a loop and the laps found would have direction 'unknown'.
Fix: for back-and-forth runs on a linear track or arm, use detect_trials(env, times, positions, regions=[start, end]); to segment round trips against a template, pass method='reference' with reference_lap=.
